scope: unweighted electron_sector/eS2o on variation shard 1. 3D Bayesian phi_h, 424 fitted cells, Q2-y 1-17. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication.
start_mode: manual. Spline B windows are tight (median width 0.020, 945 of 1390 narrower than 0.05), so --use_spline_init was not used.
changed: Limits pinned the first pass and the second pass only moves a parameter halfway, so A(1+B cos phi+C cos 2phi) was flatter than the histogram. Starts were moved to the histogram cosine and the excluding limits were widened in refine_init.py. Remade Q2-y 9 with --unfolding_3D --fit_corrections Bayesian --fit_error_source histogram --fit_init_file, no pass cap and no chi-squared stop. All 1 improved. Worst (9, 7) 1.75 to 1.13. Other cells in those Q2-y bins did not move, and unselected Q2-y bins are unchanged. JSON still has 424 cells. The shared manual initializer and the universal spline file were not edited.
left_bins: No 5D family, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Histogram shapes that disagree with a neighbor were kept, including (9,7) B -0.463 beside (9,8) B 0.010.
unresolved: Further guide changes do not help bins whose free cosine already matches, including shapes with one high phi bin or a phi hole. Empty histograms stay N/A and are not zeroes. Sparse failed-rule bins were not given a nominal value.
